annotations.title: Check whether a phone is on WhatsApp

description: Ask WhatsApp whether a phone number has an account, and get its profile picture when it does. Brazilian mobiles are checked with and without the extra 9 and the answer reports the form that actually matched. If WhatsApp cannot be reached the answer assumes yes and sets `verified: false`. An outage must not block sends to real people. Free.

from.description: Which of your WhatsApp numbers sends this: its id or its phone number. Optional: with a single connected number it is resolved for you.

phone.description: The phone number to look up, e.g. +5511988887777.
